verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own source-maps docs say that minified JavaScript requires giving Rollbar access to your source maps, and that stack traces then show the original filename, line number, method name and code coordinates. That delivers the de-minification outcome. The evidence never describes how maps are uploaded from CI, whether via an upload API, a CLI or a bundler plugin. Missing for 10: documented CI upload mechanism (CLI or bundler/webpack plugin), source-map upload API details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
